Name: Kenneth's Daily Helper - Useful Mail Every Day
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Not quotes. Not stories. Just useful help.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Daily Helper is your veteran farmer friend who whispers one practical tip every morning. What to plant for profit, how to skip mine floors with staircases, where to fish for catfish on rainy days, when to upgrade tools.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Perfect for new players who don't want to google everything, and even useful for veterans who forget stuff.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 112 Unique Mails - One practical tip per day.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Real Gameplay Help - Parsnips ready in 4 days, Salmonberries Spring 15-18 free food, bring 99 stones for staircases, kegs double crop value, etc.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Birthday reminders included - Who has birthday today and what they love.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- No fluff, just help.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Example: "Salmonberries are everywhere from Spring 15 to 18. Pick as many as you can, they are free food and great for gifts and energy."[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made by Kf - for farmers who want to play smarter, not harder.[/b][/size]
